api.sink: caller-owned; callbacks provisional until Completed; no filesystem output/publication adapter

policy.path: normal absolute drive paths only; no canonicalization, case folding, verbatim/UNC or reparse fallback
policy.inventory_names: printable ASCII 1..255 bytes; reject Windows ambiguous punctuation/trailing dot or space and unobservable/irrelevant nonregular or reparse entries; stricter than Linux
policy.identity: full root/final-directory/file snapshots, ancestor object identity via existing platform leases; metadata-only verification, not an atomic snapshot or content authentication
policy.absence: verified genuine absence retained; later appearance, replacement or observed mutation permanently poisons source
policy.read: complete bounded reads, actual EOF and SHA-256 before return; repeated reads bind full identity and digest
policy.ordering: drop enumeration iterator before final directory lease verification; drop file lease before independent root/directory guards
policy.protected_cleanup: reserve_after pre-admits separate cleanup work before file acquisition; exact_name reserves final directory check before enumeration; body work cannot consume cleanup allowance
policy.changed_priority: finish_tile preserves an already observed changed result and failed=true even if subsequent inventory verification refuses on limits
policy.early_error_boundary: inherited high-level open_rows/source-setup admission/parser errors can precede whole-inventory final verification; no atomic concurrent-mutation exclusion claim for these failures
policy.queries: existing checked queries unchanged; source/model reads outside queries
policy.errors: static redacted codes, no raw OS paths or error strings

limits.scope: actual retained capacities, growth overlap and separate transient lease allowance charged; conservative logical admission, not allocator rounding, RSS or all CPU/kernel work
limits.read_statistics: successful complete chunks only; failed primitive prefixes and EOF probe bytes excluded

validation.static_tests: static source consistency only; not runtime proof

wine.unknown_scope: unresolved syscall class; no safe/nonnetwork assumption; zero recognized IP attempts is not complete zero-attempt evidence
wine.cleanup: all 112 traced finite servers natural exit0; redundant prefix-k skipped, not proof of every possible descendant
wine.scope: synthetic Wine semantics only; actual NTFS, real input, Windows product/runtime and full extraction unaccepted; historical original report preserved, qualification sidecars supersede its trace-completeness claim

validation.history: prior initial resource-cap failure, aggregate-filter timeout, exact8 infinite-server timeout, exact8 cleanup refusal and full56 network/completeness failures remain historical; no failed report rewritten
